verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://developer.paddle.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an official docs index. Paddle also publishes sectioned llms files (migrate.txt, sdks.txt, changelog.txt), .md versions of every doc page, a docs MCP server, and agent skills written for agents and discoverable at a .well-known index. It also publishes an LLM benchmark page with explicit instructions for agents, so every part of the story is covered with first-party docs plus hands-on verification.
